how: tools/official_downgrade_acceptance.py drives the release binary end to end with a basic-edition entitlement snapshot, a professional receipt and a local-material plan, twice, and compares the two runs

professional_asset_refused.message: runtime edition basic does not satisfy required edition professional

what_the_checks_mean.local_workflow_builds: the same CLI still builds a local-material draft while only a basic entitlement is present
